summary: Authored a 5-phase implementation plan (4h, waves [1,2][3][4][5]). Phases 1-2 independently re-execute the per-site empirical audit under the correct engine per site (ugrep for pasted Bash-tool commands in the two lean agent-instruction Markdown files; GNU grep for .sh/hook sites via their own test suites), with an explicit repair branch requiring positive-match plus negative-reject evidence. Phase 3 authors the portability guidance note under core standards with the invocation-context split as its first assertion; Phase 4 indexes, validates, and deploys it; Phase 5 consolidates the evidence table and records the two administrative follow-ups. skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md is an explicit non-goal.

artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan for the empirical word-boundary grep audit plus the portability guidance note.
